description.en: Comprehensive restaurant automation system integrating WhatsApp API, thermal hardware, and real-time analytics.

fullDescription.en: Alliafood is a mission-critical system for modern gastronomy. It transforms WhatsApp into a powerful ordering engine, fully integrated with POS hardware and kitchen display systems. It handles the entire lifecycle of a restaurant order, from customer interaction to delivery tracking and revenue analytics.

Maneja todo el ciclo de vida de un pedido, desde la interacción con el cliente hasta el seguimiento de entrega y analítica de ingresos.
